text:
Maya R: Heads up — I need to swap my primary shift tonight. flight got delayed and I won't be able to cover the 22:00-02:00 UTC block. sorry for the late ping.

Owen T: yikes — when exactly are you out? is it full block or partial?

Maya R: full block. I can cover until 21:50 UTC, but can't take pages after that.

Liam K: I can pick up the tail end (00:00-02:00 UTC) if someone else takes 22:00-00:00. anyone up for the first half?

Sophia N: I can do 22:00-00:00 but i have a call 23:15-23:45 — i'll be reachable but slower. ok?

Maya R: @Sophia N that would be great. you're secondary or primary? we need to keep primary/secondary clear so paging config is correct.

Sophia N: I can be primary for 22:00-00:00. @Liam K you take primary 00:00-02:00?

Liam K: yep i'll be primary 00:00-02:00. @Sophia N can you be secondary 00:00-01:00 so we have overlap after your call?

Sophia N: sure. i'll stay secondary until 01:00 then drop off.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident bot: schedule change detected. Please confirm manual paging config update if this swap is short notice. Link: https://redwood.internal/schedule

Maya R: Confirming manual update needed. i'm not in the rotation for tonight after 21:50.

Owen T: I'll update the rotation in PagerDuty and the oncall spreadsheet unless you want me to do both?

Maya R: please update PagerDuty and add a note in the handoff doc. put this in the thread so ops knows timeline.

Owen T: Will do. quick checklist for the swap: 
- update PagerDuty primary/secondary for the two shifts
- add handoff note in /docs/oncall/handoffs.md with timestamps and contact numbers
- set a short-term escalation rule if both miss ack (5m -> 10m)
- adjust incident-bot paging if needed

Liam K: ping me when PagerDuty is updated so i can run the sanity check (test page to my phone).

Owen T: Done. PagerDuty updated: 
- 22:00-00:00 primary: Sophia N (id: pd_789) secondary: Owen T
- 00:00-02:00 primary: Liam K (id: pd_456) secondary: Sophia N until 01:00

Owen T: added handoff note here: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/handoffs.md#1795002468 — includes reason: flight delay, contact: +1-555-0123, early-coverage overlap 00:00-01:00.

Sophia N: sanity check: runbook for ramping CPU memory alerts is /runbooks/infra/cpu-memory.md — i keep that open at night.

Liam K: i'll run the test page now. reply with ack in thread once you get it.

eng-oncall-bot: Test page sent to Liam K via SMS. status: delivered.

Liam K: got it. ack. phone vibrated.

Maya R: thanks all. two small follow-ups: 
1) can someone set the temporary escalation policy (5m ack window) just for tonight?
2) if an incident >sev2 occurs between 23:30-00:30, tag me in thread and i'll try to join remotely.

Owen T: set escalation rule to 5m for tonight at 21:55 UTC — reverted automatically at 02:15 UTC. config id: esc_2026_05.

Owen T: also added a runbook pointer in the handoff note: ``Start with the GPU queue check -> verify model-serving pool (redwood-runtime svc) -> if >80% CPU, scale to dedicated pool using `rctl scale` snippet``

Sophia N: noted on sev2. i'll tag you and call if it looks bad. :phone: 23:15 call window covered.

Liam K: leaving a short playbook here for anyone covering midnight rollover: 
1) check autoscaler logs: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler --since=10m`
2) check KV cache hit rate in console -> if <45% consider cache warmup request
3) if latency >500ms, route traffic to compatible quantized model variant (see /models/catalog)

Maya R: appreciate it. one last ask — @Owen T can you run the post-swap check at 00:05 to ensure secondary assignment is correct and the escalation rule is active?

Owen T: will do. i'll post confirmation here when done.

(00:05) Owen T: post-swap check complete. PagerDuty shows Liam primary, Sophia secondary until 01:00, escalation rule active. test alerts fired and acknowledged by Liam and Sophia.

Sophia N: thanks — i'm available on slack and phone. good luck y'all. :thumbsup:

Liam K: all set. I'll escalate if anything weird pops up.

Maya R: thanks team. logging this for audit: swap initiated by Maya (flight delay), confirmed by Owen, coverage by Sophia + Liam, escalation adjusted.

Owen T: added audit note to handoff doc and tagged infra-ops. done.

Maya R: closing thread — i'll follow up in the morning if any fallout. good night :sleeping:
